meta.name: State of Siege 26 11
meta.description:
When Mumbai was under siege in 2008, it was the NSG commandos that came to its rescue. Witness the untold stories of the brave heroes and the lesser-known facts of the horrid Mumbai attacks that shook the whole world.

Ended · First aired 20 Mar 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: Contiloe Pictures · Network: ZEE5, nabd alqalb studio

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: The Calm Before Storm
videos.overview: In Mumbai, the city of dreams, life goes on as usual without any hint of the impending danger. Elsewhere, Col. Sahota and his men await the much-needed up-gradation of NSG, while Parvati, a budding journalist, struggles to get her story approved by INN Channel.

videos.title: This is War
videos.overview: What initially seemed like a gang war, soon turns out to be the deadliest terrorist attack ever in the country. The CST station, Leopold Café, Taj Hotel, Oberoi Hotel, and Chabad House are attacked simultaneously. The Mumbai Police try to fight this attack but find it difficult to beat the well-trained and highly equipped LET terrorists. Stuck in the crossfire, Parvati uses this opportunity to report the news and get noticed by her seniors.

videos.title: The Countdown Begins
videos.overview: Kasab and Ismail enter Cama hospital while the NSG team leaves for Mumbai. The fight between the Mumbai police and the terrorists continues. The Jew hostages are killed, and many others are held captive. Meanwhile, Parvati stumbles upon survivors at the Chambers Club and interviews them live on-air. This broadcast is watched by the Pakistani handlers and used to provide updates to the terrorists.

videos.title: State of Siege
videos.overview: The terrorists are a step ahead of the forces. Kasab and Ismail shoot the ATS chief, but later, Ismail is killed, and Kasab is captured. Much to the respite of the hostages, the marine commandos arrive. Parvati finally gets Andreas on line. A firefight ensues between the MARCOS and the terrorists, and the NSG arrives to take charge of the situation.

videos.title: Counter Strike
videos.overview: On day two, the NSG team at Hotel Taj Palace start evacuating the floors one by one. The second NSG team, led by Col Das, reaches Chabad house to rescue the Israeli hostages. Meanwhile, the Police take Kasab to a safer place and start the procedure of presenting him to the magistrate. At the Oberoi hotel, the NSG manages to gain control. However, the fight continues at the Chambers, where the terrorists are in constant touch with Lakhvi.

videos.title: Commando Down
videos.overview: At the Taj, Mani goes missing, and a worried Kunal sends his men to search for him. The commandos try to enter the Chabad House through the roof via a helicopter, but the live coverage on TV allows Lakhvi to pass on the exact details of this operation to the terrorists. Meanwhile, Santosh is excited about his channel’s improved TRP but fails to understand the damage the coverage has done to the operation.

videos.title: Black Tornado - The Final Battle
videos.overview: All the terrorists at Chabad House are killed. At the Taj Hotel, Kunal and his team enter the kitchen for a final face-off with the terrorists. Meanwhile, Santosh is criticiSed for sensationaliSing a national tragedy. Kunal presents the Operation Black Tornado report. Meanwhile, Hafiz Saeed continues to hire new recruits for Jaish-e-Mohammed and a new recruit joins NSG to defend India against future threats.

videos.title: Bonus Feature – The Making of a Terrorist
videos.overview: During the interrogation, Kasab spills the beans and reveals important details and narrates the story of how he became a jihadi. He talks about his recruitment in Jaish-e-Mohammed and life in Daure-aam and Daure-khaas and how terror camps are run in an organised fashion.
